points.point: Vault 的實際 RFIC/半導體案例：Samsung Foundry RF/Analog Enablement Group，DUT 為 5G SoC including VCO，使用 FSWP50（analyzer）+ SMW200A 44GHz / SGS100A（signal generator）
points.label: partial
points.why: mentions SMW200A/analyzer generally, but not Samsung Foundry, 5G SoC incl. VCO, FSWP50, SGS100A

points.point: 該案例的量測在 probe station 上進行，並搭配自動化 VCO tuning 軟體，顯示儀器位於晶片級 characterization / validation 這一步
points.label: partial
points.why: only says test/validation; omits probe station and automated VCO tuning/chip-level characterization evidence

points.point: 測試區塊對儀器類別的 mapping：RefClk 與 PLL jitter performance 由 phase noise analyzers 與 signal generators 負責
points.label: missing
points.why: no RefClk/PLL jitter or phase-noise analyzer mapping

points.point: ADC / DAC frontend performance 由 spectrum analyzers 與 signal generators 負責，是 signal generator / analyzer 在高速數位 / 混訊晶片驗證中的另一個落點
points.label: missing

points.point: RFIC 的 bare board / socket / transmission line 評估這一段，來源明示的 fit 是 VNAs，而非 signal generator / analyzer
points.label: missing

points.point: 2026.7 DDT success stories 把 SoC testing 對應到 FSWP、SMA100B（RF and Microwave Signal Generator）與 ZNA67
points.label: missing
points.why: no DDT SoC testing mapping to FSWP/SMA100B/ZNA67

points.point: Vault 明示不推論這些儀器在各應用中的角色分工（stimulus / analysis / phase noise / VNA / automation），因此「流程位置」只能到 mapping 層級
points.label: contradicted
points.why: asserts stimulus/interferer and analyzer roles despite Vault not defining role split

points.point: Samsung 案例被歸納為可包裝成 RF / analog enablement 測試方案，但軟體正式名稱與版本未標示
points.label: missing
points.why: no RF/analog enablement packaging or software name/version caveat

invented: generator supplies RF/vector stimulus or interferers to the DUT
analyzer measures and analyzes the DUT’s RF output or emissions
SMW200A is used in 5G NR receiver/transmitter test setups and as an interferer source
FSW is used to execute RF measurements in transmitter tests and receiver spurious-emissions tests
